task_description: relu(A @ B + bias) for 128x128x128 bf16 matmul, comparing two separate pallas_call invocations (matmul, then epilogue) against one fused invocation.

metrics.name: num_pallas_calls
metrics.description: number of pallas_call invocations in workload(). Naive: 2 (the intermediate matmul result round-trips through HBM between them). Optimized: 1. Exact and verifiable from the code alone.

metrics.name: achieved_tflops_pct_of_peak_bf16
metrics.description: achieved throughput as % of v5e peak bf16 TFLOPS (197.0), same convention as 01_mxu_feed. Secondary/confirmatory signal here -- num_pallas_calls is the more direct one.
